note: Phased CSD training program. Each phase declares what it consumes, what method it applies, what it must achieve to pass, and what was ACTUALLY measured. `actual` stays null until a run fills it from a receipt -- it is never hand-written, because a hand-written result is a claim rather than a measurement. A phase whose gate fails does not advance; the curriculum in docs/program/CSD-BRAIN-REGIONS.md is explicit that skipping per-region pretrain is not a shortcut.
thesis: Trillion-parameter-class capability from a small multi-region mind. Success is capability PER PARAMETER, so 'more parameters' is never an acceptable answer to a failed gate.

gate_policy.why: Advancing past a failed gate is how an unpretrained region becomes dead weight: the softmax gate collapses onto whichever region moved first, and every later number is measured against a broken mind.
gate_policy.intended_vs_actual: Every phase records both. A phase that passes its numeric gate but does not do what it was supposed to do is a FAIL, and the discrepancy is the finding.

phases.title: Substrate
phases.why: Nothing downstream is measurable without a real corpus path, a real tokenizer, and an eval harness that can detect contamination.
deliverables: corpus pipeline: parquet -> GPT-2 BPE -> packed windows, 488k tok/s
token-level feature-hashing encoder (separation +0.79 vs ~0 for the whole-line hash it replaced)
declarative region specs + honest catalogue (live/available default false)
component role protocols: encoder / region / decoder / classifier / ranker
eval metrics + contamination guard (catches reformatted duplicates)
I-JEPA with EMA target, stop-gradient, asymmetric predictor

phases.title: Per-region pretrain, isolated
phases.why: Curriculum step 1, mandatory. A region that never sees its own job-shaped data before assembly becomes dead weight.

regions.name: compress
regions.method: InfoNCE on AllNLI triplets; STS-B graded pairs as held-out correlation

regions.name: retrieve
regions.method: InfoNCE query->passage; needs qrels to link corpus and queries
regions.blocked_by: qrels not present in the BeIR download; corpus and queries are separate files with no relevance links

phases.title: Per-region evaluation and characterisation
phases.why: The operator's stated interest: validate each submodel, benchmark it, learn what matters and what does not BEFORE composing.
measures: held-out task metric per region, on a contamination-checked split
parameters, and capability per parameter against the region's gate
intended vs actual: does the region do its declared job, or merely score well

phases.title: Post-training quantization, per region
phases.why: Quantization is a first-class experiment here, not an afterthought. Training runs at full precision; PTQ comes after, so a quantized region can be compared against the full-precision one that produced it.
phases.method: calibrated uniform PTQ at 8/4/2 bits per region, each measured against its own P2 baseline

gate.quality_delta: regression named per metric, never averaged
gate.note: compare() reports per-metric; a size win with a quality loss is not a win

phases.known_limitation: sub-8-bit currently buys no space: one code is one uint8 regardless of bits. Real sub-byte packing is required before 2/4-bit ratios mean anything.

phases.title: Router training
phases.why: Curriculum step 2. Regions must be pretrained first or the gate collapses onto whichever moved first.
phases.method: softmax gate + Switch aux load balance N*sum(f_i*P_i), top_k=1 until load is measured non-collapsed on a labelled batch

gate.load_balance: no region below 0.1 share on a labelled batch

phases.title: Composed mind
phases.why: Curriculum step 3. Only meaningful once each part is independently verified.

phases.title: Foundation / scale
phases.why: Curriculum step 4. Foundation corpora (FineWeb/C4/Pile) are LAST, not first. The causal LM backbone is already written and fenced for this.
